canonical_operational_title: Full Four-Domain RA-MedFiLM-BARR Integration & Canonical Bundle Freeze
phase26_operational_definition: Bind the already-trained canonical GlobalMedFiLM, regional refiner, benefit router, post-safety selector, deterministic ROI/fusion rules, normalization artifacts and one fixed development-selected routing operating point into the canonical full four-domain RA-MedFiLM-BARR inference bundle, without changing any learned parameter.
scientific_rationale: All learned components were already independently developed and final-refit in their owning phases.
A new joint optimization stage has: no frozen loss, no frozen gradient graph, no established scientific necessity.
A new joint stage would invalidate direct transfer of Phase25 modular evidence.
Phase26 MUST NOT invent end-to-end training merely because the historical roadmap used the word 'Training'.
